pages.title: Collect SMS opt-in
pages.subtitle: What a compliant opt-in looks like, with a real example and a simple checklist.

blocks.statement: A phone number alone is not consent

blocks.heading: Every opt-in must include
blocks.intro: Use the Brightside Pest Control form as a model. Every item below is a carrier requirement for your signup page.

rows.definition: Clearly labeled and optional to fill in
Person actively checks it; never pre-checked
Exact registered name in the opt-in language
What texts they will receive (reminders, offers)
Msg & data rates, frequency varies, STOP, HELP
Separate checkbox with links to both policies

blocks.title: Split consent by message type
blocks.text: One checkbox for all SMS is the #1 rejection reason. Transactional, marketing, and Terms each need their own unchecked box.

pages.title: Make your form
pages.subtitle: Privacy language, sample messages, and the disclosures carriers check.

blocks.heading: Three separate checkboxes
blocks.intro: Each message type needs its own unchecked checkbox, plus a separate Terms acknowledgment.

rows.definition: Appointment and account texts with frequency and rate disclosures
Offers and promotions; consent is not a condition of purchase
Accept Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, with links

paragraphs.text: Your Privacy Policy must say you do not sell or share mobile numbers, SMS consent, or message data with third parties for marketing. Share only with service providers to operate your SMS program.
"Message frequency may vary. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out; HELP for help."
"Hi, check out our updates." Generic placeholders like this get rejected by carriers.
"Brightside Pest Control: Hi Jane, your appointment is confirmed for Tue 3/12. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for assistance."

pages.title: Review before
pages.subtitle: Common mistakes to avoid and a checklist to clear carrier review.

blocks.heading: What gets a form rejected
blocks.intro: Avoid these and you will clear review the first time around.

rows.definition: One box covering all SMS types fails review
Consent must be actively checked, never defaulted
Form submission alone is not valid opt-in
No STOP, HELP, brand name, or rate disclosures

blocks.heading: Pre-submission checklist
blocks.intro: Run through this before you submit.

rows.definition: Matches registration, website, and sample messages
Dedicated, optional number field on the form
Separate, unchecked, one per message type
Own checkbox with links; rates, STOP, HELP nearby
Brand name, realistic content, and opt-out language

blocks.title: Need a hand?
blocks.text: Your Salesmsg team is happy to review your opt-in form before you submit. A two-minute check can save days of back-and-forth.
